stanzas.sanskrit:
साल्वो भैष्मीविवाहे यदुबलविजितश्चन्द्रचूडाद्विमानं
विन्दन् सौभं स मायी त्वयि वसति कुरुंस्त्वत्पुरीमभ्यभाङ्क्षीत् ।
प्रद्युम्नस्तं निरुन्धन् निखिलयदुभटैर्न्यग्रहीदुग्रवीर्यं
तस्यामात्यं द्युमन्तं व्यजनि च समरः सप्तविंशत्यहान्तम् ॥ ८६-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Saalvan was defeated during Rukmini kalyanam by Yadava army. He prayed to Lord Shiva and got Soubham, the aerial car as boon. When Krishna left to Indraprastha for the Rajasooya Yagna, Saalvan attacked Dwaraka. Pradyumna fought with him courageously and killed his minister Dhyuman. The battle went on for 27 days.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sālvo bhaiṣmīvivāhe yadubalavijitaścandracūḍādvimānaṃ
vindan saubhaṃ sa māyī tvayi vasati kuruṃstvatpurīmabhyabhāṅkṣīt |
pradyumnastaṃ nirundhan nikhilayadubhaṭairnyagrahīdugravīryaṃ
tasyāmātyaṃ dyumantaṃ vyajani ca samaraḥ saptaviṃśatyahāntam || 86-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तावत्त्वं रामशाली त्वरितमुपगतः खण्डितप्रायसैन्यं
सौभेशं तं न्यरुन्धाः स च किल गदया शार्ङ्गमभ्रंशयत् ते ।
मायातातं व्यहिंसीदपि तव पुरतस्तत्त्वयापि क्षणार्धं
नाज्ञायीत्याहुरेके तदिदमवमतं व्यास एव न्यषेधीत् ॥ ८६-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna came to Dwaraka with Balarama and destroyed Saalvan's army. Saalvan pushed Krishna's bow and arrow down and with his magic made an illusion of Vasudeva and killed him, to confuse Krishna. Some say that even Krishna did not realise that it was an illusion for some time. But Sage Vyasa has denied that fact.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāvattvaṃ rāmaśālī tvaritamupagataḥ khaṇḍitaprāyasainyaṃ
saubheśaṃ taṃ nyarundhāḥ sa ca kila gadayā śārṅgamabhraṃśayat te |
māyātātaṃ vyahiṃsīdapi tava puratastattvayāpi kṣaṇārdhaṃ
nājñāyītyāhureke tadidamavamataṃ vyāsa eva nyaṣedhīt || 86-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
क्षिप्त्वा सौभं गदाचूर्णितमुदकनिधौ मङ्क्षु साल्वेऽपि चक्रे-
-णोत्कृत्ते दन्तवक्त्रः प्रसभमभिपतन्नभ्यमुञ्चद्गदां ते ।
कौमोदक्या हतोऽसावपि सुकृतनिधिश्चैद्यवत् प्रापदैक्यं
सर्वेषामेष पूर्वं त्वयि धृतमनसां मोक्षणार्थोऽवतारः ॥ ८६-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna broke the aerial car with his mace and threw it in the ocean. Krishna killed Saalvan by chopping his head with the Sudarshan Chakra. Dantavakra opposed Krishna and continued to fight. Krishna took his Kowmodahi and killed Dantavakra. Since he was virtuous and devoted to Krishna in his previous birth, he merged with Bhagwan just like Shishupala and attained salvation, Bhattathiri wondered, if Krishna's avatar itself was only to give salvation to his devotees who had

stanzas.stanza_roman:
kṣiptvā saubhaṃ gadācūrṇitamudakanidhau maṅkṣu sālve’pi cakre-
-ṇotkṛtte dantavaktraḥ prasabhamabhipatannabhyamuñcadgadāṃ te |
kaumodakyā hato’sāvapi sukṛtanidhiścaidyavat prāpadaikyaṃ
sarveṣāmeṣa pūrvaṃ tvayi dhṛtamanasāṃ mokṣaṇārtho’vatāraḥ || 86-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वय्यायातेऽथ जाते किल कुरुसदसि द्यूतके सम्यतायाः
क्रन्दन्त्या याज्ञसेन्याः सकरुणमकृथाश्चेलमालामनन्ताम् ।
अन्नान्तप्राप्तशर्वांशजमुनिचकितद्रौपदीचिन्तितोऽथ
प्राप्तः शाकान्नमश्नन् मुनिगणमकृथास्तृप्तिमन्तं वनान्ते ॥ ८६-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
After Krishna returned to Dwaraka, a fraudulent game of dice took place in the assembly of the Kurus. Draupadi was dragged there by her hair. Piteously and helplessly crying she prayed to Bhagwan. With compassion Bhagwan endowed her with endless length of clothing.
Further, when living in the forest, Draupadi was frightened because sage Durvaasaa had come there with his people when the food was over. Draupadi again thought of Bhagwan. Krishna ate a bit of the left over
stanzas.commentary_note: Facebook caption truncated at "See more"; the remaining words are not available in the intake.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvayyāyāte’tha jāte kila kurusadasi dyūtake samyatāyāḥ
krandantyā yājñasenyāḥ sakaruṇamakṛthāścelamālāmanantām |
annāntaprāptaśarvāṃśajamunicakitadraupadīcintito’tha
prāptaḥ śākānnamaśnan munigaṇamakṛthāstṛptimantaṃ vanānte || 86-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
युद्धोद्योगेऽथ मन्त्रे मिलति सति वृतः फल्गुनेन त्वमेकः
कौरव्ये दत्तसैन्यः करिपुरमगमो दूत्यकृत् पाण्डवार्थम् ।
भीष्मद्रोणादिमान्ये तव खलु वचने धिक्कृते कौरवेण
व्यावृण्वन् विश्वरूपं मुनिसदसि पुरीं क्षोभयित्वाऽऽगतोऽभूः ॥ ८६-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: As the preparations of the war were on and strategies were decided, Arjuna asked Krishna alone to be on his side. Agreeing to that, Krishna gave HIS army to Duryodhana. Taking on the role of a messenger of the Pandavas, Bhagwan went to Hastinaapur. Krishna’s words were honoured by Bhishma, Drona and others but Duryodhana rejected them altogether. Revealing Bhagwan’s Cosmic form in the assembly of the sages, the entire Hastinapur was shaken and returned to Dwaraka.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yuddhodyoge’tha mantre milati sati vṛtaḥ phalgunena tvamekaḥ
kauravye dattasainyaḥ karipuramagamo dūtyakṛt pāṇḍavārtham |
bhīṣmadroṇādimānye tava khalu vacane dhikkṛte kauraveṇa
vyāvṛṇvan viśvarūpaṃ munisadasi purīṃ kṣobhayitvā”gato’bhūḥ || 86-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
जिष्णोस्त्वं कृष्ण सूतः खलु समरमुखे बन्धुघाते दयालुं
खिन्नं तं वीक्ष्य वीरं किमिदमयि सखे नित्य एकोऽयमात्मा ।
को वध्यः कोऽत्र हन्ता तदिह वधभियं प्रोज्झ्य मय्यर्पितात्मा
धर्म्यं युद्धं चरेति प्रकृतिमनयथा दर्शयन् विश्वरूपम् ॥ ८६-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna found that Arjuna was sad and worried in the face of the war, with the pitiful thought of having to kill his relations and his own people. Krishna advised Arjuna that Aatma is eternal and one. There is an atma in every form of life which is pure and cannot be destroyed. Hence asked him to leave the fear of killing his relatives and asked him to surrender his mind to Krishna and do his rightful duty as Kshatriya. Krishna revealed his cosmic form to Arjuna which rest
stanzas.commentary_note: Facebook caption truncated at "See more"; the remaining words are not available in the intake.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jiṣṇostvaṃ kṛṣṇa sūtaḥ khalu samaramukhe bandhughāte dayāluṃ
khinnaṃ taṃ vīkṣya vīraṃ kimidamayi sakhe nitya eko’yamātmā |
ko vadhyaḥ ko’tra hantā tadiha vadhabhiyaṃ projjhya mayyarpitātmā
dharmyaṃ yuddhaṃ careti prakṛtimanayathā darśayan viśvarūpam || 86-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
भक्तोत्तंसेऽथ भीष्मे तव धरणिभरक्षेपकृत्यैकसक्ते
नित्यं नित्यं विभिन्दत्यवनिभृदयुतं प्राप्तसादे च पार्थे ।
निश्शस्त्रत्वप्रतिज्ञां विजहदरिवरं धारयन् क्रोधशाली-
-वाधावन् प्राञ्जलिं तं नतशिरसमथो वीक्ष्य मोदादपागाः ॥ ८६-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bheeshma, one of the great devotees of Krishna, killed 10000 warriors everyday to aid Krishna's intention of reducing the evil in the world. Arjuna had become tired of resisting Bheeshma's arrows. Krishna who had vowed not to take weapons in the war, broke the vow and took the Sudarshan Chakra and ran towards Bheeshma as if he was angry. Bheeshma put his weapons down and put his head down and prayed to Krishna. This pleased Krishna.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhaktottaṃse’tha bhīṣme tava dharaṇibharakṣepakṛtyaikasakte
nityaṃ nityaṃ vibhindatyavanibhṛdayutaṃ prāptasāde ca pārthe |
niśśastratvapratijñāṃ vijahadarivaraṃ dhārayan krodhaśālī-
-vādhāvan prāñjaliṃ taṃ nataśirasamatho vīkṣya modādapāgāḥ || 86-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
युद्धे द्रोणस्य हस्तिस्थिररणभगदत्तेरितं वैष्णवास्त्रं
वक्षस्याधत्त चक्रस्थगितरविमहाः प्रार्दयत् सिन्धुराजम् ।
नागास्त्रे कर्णमुक्ते क्षितिमवनमयन् केवलं कृत्तमौलिं
तत्रे तत्राऽपि पार्थं किमिव न हि भवान् पाण्डवानामकार्षीत् ॥ ८६-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
When the fight with Drona was going on, Bhagadatta who was seated on an elephant, used the Vaishnava missile which Krishna took it on HIS own chest and saved Arjuna.
Then HE masked sunlight and made Arjuna kill Jayathrathan.
Karna used his Naagastram to kill Arjuna. Krishna stepped his foot hard and made the chariot go few inches below the earth and let the arrow take Arjuna's crown but spare his life.
Bhattathiri was surprised at the various feats of Krishna to protect Pandavas.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yuddhe droṇasya hastisthiraraṇabhagadatteritaṃ vaiṣṇavāstraṃ
vakṣasyādhatta cakrasthagitaravimahāḥ prārdayat sindhurājam |
nāgāstre karṇamukte kṣitimavanamayan kevalaṃ kṛttamauliṃ
tatre tatrā’pi pārthaṃ kimiva na hi bhavān pāṇḍavānāmakārṣīt || 86-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
युद्धादौ तीर्थगामी स खलु हलधरो नैमिशक्षेत्रमृच्छ-
-न्नप्रत्युत्थायि सूतक्षयकृदथ सुतं तत्पदे कल्पयित्वा ।
यज्ञघ्नं बल्वलं पर्वणि परिदलयन् स्नाततीर्थो रणान्ते
सम्प्राप्तो भीमदुर्योधनरणमशमं वीक्ष्य यातः पुरीं ते ॥ ८६-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Before the start of the battle, Balaram had gone away on a pilgrimage to Naimishaaranya. Then he killed Suta for not having got up to honour him and installed his son in his place.
Then he destroyed the Asura Valkala, who used to destroy the Yagnyas carried out on the full moon and new moon days.
Completing his pilgrimage he returned to Kurukshetra.
There when he saw the prolonged fight between Bheema and Duryodhana, he went to Dwaraka.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yuddhādau tīrthagāmī sa khalu haladharo naimiśakṣetramṛccha-
-nnapratyutthāyi sūtakṣayakṛdatha sutaṃ tatpade kalpayitvā |
yajñaghnaṃ balvalaṃ parvaṇi paridalayan snātatīrtho raṇānte
samprāpto bhīmaduryodhanaraṇamaśamaṃ vīkṣya yātaḥ purīṃ te || 86-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
संसुप्तद्रौपदेयक्षपणहतधियं द्रौणिमेत्य त्वदुक्त्या
तन्मुक्तं ब्राह्ममस्त्रं समहृत विजयो मौलिरत्नं च जह्रे ।
उच्छित्त्यै पाण्डवानां पुनरपि च विशत्युत्तरागर्भमस्त्रे
रक्षन्नङ्गुष्ठमात्रः किल जठरमगाश्चक्रपाणिर्विभो त्वम् ॥ ८६-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Drona's son Ashwathama killed Draupadi's sons while they were sleeping.
On Krishna’s command Arjuna approached him and retracted the Brahmaastram used by him and clipped off his crest jewel. To cut off the line of the Paandavas, Ashwathama again sent the weapon into Uttara's womb to kill the foetus in there. Bhagwan entered her womb in the size of a thumb with Sudarshana discus & protected the foetus.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
saṃsuptadraupadeyakṣapaṇahatadhiyaṃ drauṇimetya tvaduktyā
tanmuktaṃ brāhmamastraṃ samahṛta vijayo mauliratnaṃ ca jahre |
ucchittyai pāṇḍavānāṃ punarapi ca viśatyuttarāgarbhamastre
rakṣannaṅguṣṭhamātraḥ kila jaṭharamagāścakrapāṇirvibho tvam || 86-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
धर्मौघं धर्मसूनोरभिदधदखिलं छन्दमृत्युः स भीष्म-
-स्त्वां पश्यन् भक्तिभूम्नैव हि सपदि ययौ निष्कलब्रह्मभूयम् ।
सम्याज्याथाश्वमेधैस्त्रिभिरतिमहितैर्धर्मजं पूर्णकामं
सम्प्राप्तो द्वारकां त्वं पवनपुरपते पाहि मां सर्वरोगात् ॥ ८६-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en:
Bheeshma who was defeated in the war and who had the power of deciding the moment of his death, was lying in the bed of arrows. He advised all about Dharmas to Yudhisthira. Then by his will, keeping his vision fixed on Krishna, Bheeshma took his last breath and attained Salvation. Krishna enabled Yudhisthira to perform three yagnas to fulfill all his aspirations and returned to Dwaraka.
Bhattathiri worshipped Bhagwan who did so much acts to protect Pandavas and uphold Dh

stanzas.stanza_roman:
dharmaughaṃ dharmasūnorabhidadhadakhilaṃ chandamṛtyuḥ sa bhīṣma-
-stvāṃ paśyan bhaktibhūmnaiva hi sapadi yayau niṣkalabrahmabhūyam |
samyājyāthāśvamedhaistribhiratimahitairdharmajaṃ pūrṇakāmaṃ
samprāpto dvārakāṃ tvaṃ pavanapurapate pāhi māṃ sarvarogāt || 86-11 ||
